run_all_reduce_tpu: run an all-reduce collective operation across TPU cores using xm.all_reduce with a specified reduce op
run_all_gather_tpu: run an all-gather collective operation to gather tensors from all TPU workers along dimension 0
run_all_to_all_tpu: run an all-to-all collective operation to scatter and gather tensor chunks across all TPU workers
run_benchmark_comms_tpu: run a communication benchmark on TPU by spawning xmp processes across all TPU cores
run_alloc_embedding_tpu: run allocation of an EmbeddingBag table with random uniform weights on a TPU device
